app.R29vZ2xlRHJpdmU.short_desc.message: Connect with Google Drive to manage your files and folders

app.R29vZ2xlRHJpdmU.desc.source: Integrate with Google Drive to manage your files and folders. This integration allows you to perform actions and respond to events in your Google Drive account, enabling you to automate file management and sharing workflows.

app.R29vZ2xlRHJpdmU.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY.source: Make a custom API call to Google Drive
app.R29vZ2xlRHJpdmU.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY.message: Make a custom API call to Google Drive

app.R29vZ2xlRHJpdmU.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Google Drive** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
